### Module 06 — Causal Inference in Health Research

# Propensity Score Methods

***
**Learning objectives**
- Estimate propensity scores using logistic regression and GBM
- Apply PS matching (nearest-neighbour, caliper, 1:k)
- Implement inverse probability of treatment weighting (IPTW)
- Assess covariate balance with Standardised Mean Differences (SMD)
- Estimate ATE and ATT with confidence intervals via bootstrap
- Compare PS matching vs IPTW trade-offs

**Estimated time:** 3 hours | **Level:** Intermediate-Advanced | **Libraries:** `MatchIt`, `WeightIt`, `cobalt`, `gbm`, `ggplot2`, `dplyr`

## 1. Setup & Shared Dataset

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(broom)
library(patchwork)
library(MatchIt)
library(WeightIt)
library(cobalt)
library(gbm)

theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
)

mod06_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "mod06")
dir.create(mod06_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

col_blue  <- "#2563EB"
col_red   <- "#DC2626"
col_green <- "#16A34A"

logistic <- function(x) 1 / (1 + exp(-x))

set.seed(42)
N <- 5000
age <- pmin(pmax(rnorm(N, 60, 12), 30), 90)
smoking <- rbinom(N, 1, logistic(-1 + 0.02 * (age - 60)))
chd_history <- rbinom(N, 1, logistic(-2 + 0.03 * (age - 60)))
ldl_baseline <- pmin(pmax(rnorm(N, 140 + 20 * smoking, 30), 60), 280)
ses_score <- rnorm(N, 0, 1)
statin_logit <- -2.0 + 0.025 * (ldl_baseline - 140) + 1.0 * chd_history +
  0.02 * (age - 60) - 0.3 * ses_score
statin <- rbinom(N, 1, logistic(statin_logit))
TRUE_EFFECT <- -0.8
mi_logit <- -3.0 + TRUE_EFFECT * statin + 0.03 * (age - 60) + 0.5 * smoking +
  0.8 * chd_history + 0.005 * (ldl_baseline - 140)
mi <- rbinom(N, 1, logistic(mi_logit))

df <- tibble(
  age = age, smoking = smoking, chd_history = chd_history,
  ldl_baseline = ldl_baseline, ses_score = ses_score,
  statin = statin, mi = mi
)
COVARIATES <- c("age", "smoking", "chd_history", "ldl_baseline", "ses_score")
ps_formula <- statin ~ age + smoking + chd_history + ldl_baseline + ses_score

cat(sprintf("N=%d | Statin=%.1f%% | MI=%.1f%% | True OR=%.3f\n",
            N, mean(statin) * 100, mean(mi) * 100, exp(TRUE_EFFECT)))
```

## 2. Propensity Score Estimation

```{r, fig.height=6, fig.width=8}
# Estimate PS with logistic regression
lr_ps <- glm(ps_formula, data = df, family = binomial())
df$ps_lr <- fitted(lr_ps)

# Estimate PS with gradient boosting (more flexible)
set.seed(42)
gb_ps <- gbm(
  ps_formula,
  data = as.data.frame(df),
  distribution = "bernoulli",
  n.trees = 200,
  interaction.depth = 4,
  shrinkage = 0.05,
  bag.fraction = 0.8,
  n.minobsinnode = 10,
  verbose = FALSE
)
df$ps_gb <- as.numeric(predict(gb_ps, newdata = as.data.frame(df),
                               n.trees = 200, type = "response"))

df_long_ps <- df |>
  select(statin, ps_lr, ps_gb) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(c(ps_lr, ps_gb), names_to = "model", values_to = "ps") |>
  mutate(
    model = recode(model,
                   ps_lr = "Logistic Regression PS",
                   ps_gb = "Gradient Boosting PS"),
    grp = if_else(statin == 1, "Treated (statin)", "Control (no statin)")
  )

p_ps_hist <- ggplot(df_long_ps, aes(x = ps, fill = grp)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(density)), bins = 40,
                 alpha = 0.6, position = "identity", colour = NA) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Control (no statin)" = col_blue,
                               "Treated (statin)" = col_red)) +
  facet_wrap(~ model) +
  labs(x = "Propensity score", y = "Density", fill = NULL)

# Calibration
calib_curve <- function(y, p, n_bins = 10) {
  breaks <- seq(0, 1, length.out = n_bins + 1)
  bin <- cut(p, breaks, include.lowest = TRUE)
  tibble(y = y, p = p, bin = bin) |>
    group_by(bin) |>
    summarise(
      mean_predicted    = mean(p),
      fraction_treated  = mean(y),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

cal_gb <- calib_curve(df$statin, df$ps_gb) |> mutate(model = "GBM PS")
cal_lr <- calib_curve(df$statin, df$ps_lr) |> mutate(model = "LR PS")
cal_df <- bind_rows(cal_gb, cal_lr)

p_cal <- ggplot(cal_df, aes(x = mean_predicted, y = fraction_treated,
                            colour = model, shape = model)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "black",
              linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("GBM PS" = col_red, "LR PS" = col_blue)) +
  labs(x = "Mean predicted PS", y = "Fraction treated",
       title = "PS Calibration", colour = NULL, shape = NULL) +
  coord_equal(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1))

p_ps <- p_ps_hist + p_cal + plot_layout(widths = c(2, 1))
print(p_ps)
ggsave(file.path(mod06_dir, "ps_distributions.png"), p_ps,
       width = 16, height = 4.5, dpi = 120)

cat(sprintf("PS range (LR): %.3f - %.3f\n", min(df$ps_lr), max(df$ps_lr)))
cat(sprintf("PS range (GB): %.3f - %.3f\n", min(df$ps_gb), max(df$ps_gb)))
```

## 3. Covariate Balance — Standardised Mean Differences

```{r}
compute_smd <- function(df_sub, treatment_col, covariates) {
  # Compute Standardised Mean Difference for each covariate.
  treat <- df_sub[df_sub[[treatment_col]] == 1, ]
  ctrl  <- df_sub[df_sub[[treatment_col]] == 0, ]
  smds <- sapply(covariates, function(cov) {
    m1 <- mean(treat[[cov]]); m0 <- mean(ctrl[[cov]])
    s1 <- sd(treat[[cov]]);   s0 <- sd(ctrl[[cov]])
    pooled_sd <- sqrt((s1^2 + s0^2) / 2)
    if (pooled_sd > 0) (m1 - m0) / pooled_sd else 0
  })
  tibble(covariate = covariates, smd = as.numeric(smds))
}

smd_unadjusted <- compute_smd(df, "statin", COVARIATES)

p_love_un <- ggplot(smd_unadjusted, aes(x = abs(smd), y = reorder(covariate, abs(smd)))) +
  geom_col(fill = col_red, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.10, colour = "black", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.25, colour = "grey50", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.8) +
  labs(
    x = "Absolute SMD", y = NULL,
    title = "Love Plot — Covariate Balance (Unadjusted)"
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.10, y = 0.6, label = "SMD=0.10", hjust = -0.1, size = 3) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.25, y = 0.6, label = "SMD=0.25 (poor balance)",
           hjust = -0.05, size = 3, colour = "grey40")

print(p_love_un)
ggsave(file.path(mod06_dir, "love_plot.png"), p_love_un,
       width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 120)

cat("Unadjusted SMDs (higher = more imbalance):\n")
smd_unadjusted |>
  mutate(abs_smd = abs(smd)) |>
  arrange(desc(abs_smd)) |>
  mutate(flag = if_else(abs_smd > 0.10, " <- IMBALANCED", "")) |>
  (\(x) {
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(x))) {
      cat(sprintf("  %-20s: %.3f%s\n", x$covariate[i], x$abs_smd[i], x$flag[i]))
    }
  })()
```

## 4. Propensity Score Matching

```{r}
# 1:1 nearest-neighbour PS matching with caliper (MatchIt)
m_out <- matchit(
  ps_formula,
  data = as.data.frame(df),
  method = "nearest",
  distance = df$ps_gb,
  caliper = 0.2,
  std.caliper = TRUE,
  ratio = 1,
  replace = FALSE
)

df_matched <- tibble(match.data(m_out))
n_treated <- sum(df_matched$statin == 1)
n_control <- sum(df_matched$statin == 0)
cat(sprintf("Matched dataset: N=%d (%d treated, %d control)\n",
            nrow(df_matched), n_treated, n_control))
cat("MatchIt summary:\n")
print(summary(m_out, un = TRUE)$nn)

smd_matched <- compute_smd(df_matched, "statin", COVARIATES)

love_cmp <- bind_rows(
  smd_unadjusted |> mutate(stage = "Before matching"),
  smd_matched    |> mutate(stage = "After PS matching")
) |>
  mutate(covariate = factor(covariate, levels = rev(COVARIATES)))

p_love_m <- ggplot(love_cmp, aes(x = abs(smd), y = covariate, fill = stage)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.65, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.10, colour = "black", linetype = "dashed",
             linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Before matching" = col_red,
                               "After PS matching" = col_blue)) +
  labs(
    x = "Absolute SMD", y = NULL, fill = NULL,
    title = "Love Plot: Before vs After PS Matching"
  )

print(p_love_m)
ggsave(file.path(mod06_dir, "love_plot_matched.png"), p_love_m,
       width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 120)

# cobalt Love plot (same comparison, package implementation)
p_cobalt <- cobalt::love.plot(
  m_out,
  stats = "mean.diffs",
  abs = TRUE,
  thresholds = c(m = 0.10),
  var.order = "unadjusted",
  colors = c(col_red, col_blue),
  title = "cobalt Love Plot: Before vs After PS Matching"
)
print(p_cobalt)
```

## 5. ATT Estimation via Matching

```{r}
estimate_att_matching <- function(df_m, treatment, outcome) {
  # Estimate ATT from matched dataset.
  r1 <- mean(df_m[[outcome]][df_m[[treatment]] == 1])
  r0 <- mean(df_m[[outcome]][df_m[[treatment]] == 0])
  log_or <- log(r1 / (1 - r1)) - log(r0 / (1 - r0))
  list(
    RD     = round(r1 - r0, 4),
    RR     = round(r1 / r0, 4),
    log_OR = round(log_or, 4),
    OR     = round(exp(log_or), 4)
  )
}

att_match <- estimate_att_matching(df_matched, "statin", "mi")
cat("ATT (Matching):\n")
cat(sprintf("  Risk difference (RD): %.4f\n", att_match$RD))
cat(sprintf("  Risk ratio (RR)     : %.4f\n", att_match$RR))
cat(sprintf("  Odds ratio (OR)     : %.4f\n", att_match$OR))
cat(sprintf("  Log-odds            : %.4f\n", att_match$log_OR))
cat(sprintf("  True log-odds       : %.4f\n", TRUE_EFFECT))
cat(sprintf("  Bias                : %+.4f\n", att_match$log_OR - TRUE_EFFECT))

# Bootstrap CI for ATT
bootstrap_att <- function(df_m, n_boot = 500, seed = 42) {
  set.seed(seed)
  ests <- replicate(n_boot, {
    idx <- sample.int(nrow(df_m), replace = TRUE)
    boot <- df_m[idx, ]
    estimate_att_matching(boot, "statin", "mi")$log_OR
  })
  as.numeric(quantile(ests, c(0.025, 0.975)))
}

ci <- bootstrap_att(df_matched)
cat(sprintf("  95%% Bootstrap CI    : (%.4f, %.4f)\n", ci[1], ci[2]))
```

## 6. Inverse Probability of Treatment Weighting (IPTW)

```{r}
# ATE weights: 1/ps for treated, 1/(1-ps) for controls
# ATT weights: 1 for treated, ps/(1-ps) for controls
# WeightIt constructs these from the GBM propensity scores
w_ate_fit <- weightit(
  statin ~ 1, data = as.data.frame(df),
  ps = df$ps_gb, estimand = "ATE"
)
w_att_fit <- weightit(
  statin ~ 1, data = as.data.frame(df),
  ps = df$ps_gb, estimand = "ATT"
)

df$w_ate <- w_ate_fit$weights
df$w_att <- w_att_fit$weights

# Truncate extreme weights at 99th percentile
for (w_col in c("w_ate", "w_att")) {
  cap <- as.numeric(quantile(df[[w_col]], 0.99))
  df[[w_col]] <- pmin(df[[w_col]], cap)
}

ess <- function(w) (sum(w)^2) / sum(w^2)

cat("Weight distributions:\n")
cat(sprintf("  ATE weights: mean=%.2f, max=%.2f, ESS=%.0f\n",
            mean(df$w_ate), max(df$w_ate), ess(df$w_ate)))
cat(sprintf("  ATT weights: mean=%.2f, max=%.2f\n",
            mean(df$w_att), max(df$w_att)))

# Weighted SMD (balance check for IPTW)
weighted_smd <- function(dat, treatment, covariates, weights) {
  smds <- sapply(covariates, function(cov) {
    idx1 <- dat[[treatment]] == 1
    idx0 <- dat[[treatment]] == 0
    w1 <- weights[idx1]; x1 <- dat[[cov]][idx1]
    w0 <- weights[idx0]; x0 <- dat[[cov]][idx0]
    m1 <- weighted.mean(x1, w1); m0 <- weighted.mean(x0, w0)
    v1 <- weighted.mean((x1 - m1)^2, w1)
    v0 <- weighted.mean((x0 - m0)^2, w0)
    pooled <- sqrt((v1 + v0) / 2)
    if (pooled > 0) (m1 - m0) / pooled else 0
  })
  tibble(covariate = covariates, smd = as.numeric(smds))
}

smd_iptw <- weighted_smd(df, "statin", COVARIATES, df$w_ate)

cat("\nWeighted SMDs (IPTW ATE):\n")
smd_iptw |>
  mutate(abs_smd = abs(smd)) |>
  arrange(desc(abs_smd)) |>
  mutate(flag = if_else(abs_smd > 0.10, " <- still imbalanced!", "")) |>
  (\(x) {
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(x))) {
      cat(sprintf("  %-20s: %.3f%s\n", x$covariate[i], x$abs_smd[i], x$flag[i]))
    }
  })()

cat("\ncobalt balance table (IPTW ATE, untrimmed weights from WeightIt):\n")
print(cobalt::bal.tab(w_ate_fit, un = TRUE, thresholds = c(m = 0.10)))
```

```{r}
# Estimate ATE using IPTW (Horvitz-Thompson estimator)
iptw_estimate <- function(dat, treatment, outcome, weight_col) {
  idx1 <- dat[[treatment]] == 1
  idx0 <- dat[[treatment]] == 0
  r1 <- sum(dat[[outcome]][idx1] * dat[[weight_col]][idx1]) /
    sum(dat[[weight_col]][idx1])
  r0 <- sum(dat[[outcome]][idx0] * dat[[weight_col]][idx0]) /
    sum(dat[[weight_col]][idx0])
  log_or <- log(r1 / (1 - r1)) - log(r0 / (1 - r0))
  list(
    RD     = round(r1 - r0, 4),
    RR     = round(r1 / r0, 4),
    log_OR = round(log_or, 4),
    OR     = round(exp(log_or), 4)
  )
}

ate_iptw <- iptw_estimate(df, "statin", "mi", "w_ate")
att_iptw <- iptw_estimate(df, "statin", "mi", "w_att")

cat("IPTW Results:\n")
cat(sprintf("%-20s %10s %10s %10s\n", "", "ATE", "ATT", "True"))
cat(paste(rep("-", 55), collapse = ""), "\n")
for (metric in c("log_OR", "OR", "RD")) {
  true_str <- if (metric == "log_OR") sprintf("%10.4f", TRUE_EFFECT) else sprintf("%10s", "N/A")
  cat(sprintf("  %-18s %10.4f %10.4f %s\n",
              metric, ate_iptw[[metric]], att_iptw[[metric]], true_str))
}
```

## 7. Knowledge Check
1. Your PS model has AUC=0.85. Is this good or bad for causal inference?
2. After IPTW, SMD for LDL is 0.03. What does this mean for the analysis?
3. ATE and ATT differ by 0.08 log-odds. Under what circumstances would these be equal?
4. Extreme PS weights (e.g. 50x) can inflate variance. What are three remedies?
5. Implement doubly-robust estimation: combine outcome regression with IPTW weights.

```{r}
# Exercise 5 — Doubly Robust (AIPW) estimator
# Outcome model (Q-model)
fit_out <- glm(
  mi ~ age + smoking + chd_history + ldl_baseline + ses_score + statin,
  data = df, family = binomial()
)

# Predict potential outcomes
df_1 <- df; df_1$statin <- 1
df_0 <- df; df_0$statin <- 0
mu1 <- predict(fit_out, newdata = df_1, type = "response")
mu0 <- predict(fit_out, newdata = df_0, type = "response")

# AIPW correction terms
ps <- df$ps_gb
A  <- df$statin
Y  <- df$mi
# ATE AIPW
aipw_1 <- mu1 + (A / ps) * (Y - mu1)
aipw_0 <- mu0 + ((1 - A) / (1 - ps)) * (Y - mu0)
ate_aipw_rd <- mean(aipw_1) - mean(aipw_0)
mu1_mean <- mean(mu1)
mu0_mean <- mean(mu0)
aipw_lor <- log(mu1_mean / (1 - mu1_mean)) - log(mu0_mean / (1 - mu0_mean))

cat("Doubly Robust (AIPW) Estimates:\n")
cat(sprintf("  ATE RD (AIPW)      : %.4f\n", ate_aipw_rd))
cat(sprintf("  Approx log-OR      : %.4f\n", aipw_lor))
cat(sprintf("  True log-OR        : %.4f\n", TRUE_EFFECT))
cat(sprintf("  Bias               : %+.4f\n", aipw_lor - TRUE_EFFECT))
cat("\n")
cat("AIPW is consistent if EITHER the PS model OR the outcome model is correct.\n")

cat("\nOutcome model (broom):\n")
print(
  broom::tidy(fit_out, conf.int = TRUE) |>
    filter(term == "statin")
)
```
